command:
set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
before_pid=$(systemctl show ssh.service -p MainPID --value)
printf 'pre_test_sshd_pid=%s\n' "$before_pid"
runuser -u helpdesk -- sudo -n /usr/bin/systemctl restart ssh
after_pid=$(systemctl show ssh.service -p MainPID --value)
printf 'helpdesk_restart_exit=0 post_test_sshd_pid=%s\n' "$after_pid"
test "$before_pid" != "$after_pid"
test "$after_pid" -gt 0
set +e
out=$(runuser -u helpdesk -- sudo -n /usr/bin/id 2>&1); id_rc=$?
printf 'unrelated_root_command_exit=%s output=%s\n' "$id_rc" "$out"
out=$(runuser -u helpdesk -- sudo -n /usr/bin/systemctl restart systemd-journald.service 2>&1); other_rc=$?
printf 'other_service_restart_exit=%s output=%s\n' "$other_rc" "$out"
out=$(runuser -u helpdesk -- sudo -n /usr/bin/systemctl stop ssh.service 2>&1); stop_rc=$?
printf 'ssh_stop_exit=%s output=%s\n' "$stop_rc" "$out"
set -e
test "$id_rc" -ne 0
test "$other_rc" -ne 0
test "$stop_rc" -ne 0
systemctl is-active ssh.service
systemctl show ssh.service -p Result -p ActiveState -p SubState --no-pager
ss -ltnp '( sport = :22 )'
ssh-keyscan -T 5 "$NODE_IP" 2>/dev/null | ssh-keygen -lf -
